name: Dr. Francis Morgan
summary: Dr. Francis Morgan of Miskatonic University joined Armitage and Rice in confronting Wilbur Whateley's monstrous legacy, arming himself with a rifle before the climactic vigil on Sentinel Hill.
description: Dr. Francis Morgan was among the men Armitage confided his conjectures to, and he saw Wilbur Whateley's body on the library floor. On the day of the confrontation he uncased a big-game rifle, relying on it despite Armitage's warning that no material weapon would help; earlier, meeting arriving policemen in the vestibule, he had urged them to postpone entering the stench-filled reading-room until the medical examiner arrived.

sources.quote: Rice, beside him, took from a valise a metal sprayer of the sort used in combating insects; whilst Morgan uncased the big-game rifle on which he relied despite his colleague's warnings that no material weapon would be of help.

Dr. Morgan, meeting them in the vestibule, was urging them for their own sakes to postpone entrance to the stench-filled reading-room till the examiner came and the prostrate thing could be covered up.
